# Morten Haulik

> Copenhagen-based spatial computing pioneer, founder of NXT/WebXR, keynote speaker and XR consultant. Available for keynotes, panels and workshops on XR, VR, WebXR and the spatial internet, and for XR strategy and WebXR consulting across Europe.

- Over a decade in XR; facilitated 100+ industry workshops; keynotes for audiences of 2,000+.
- Has presented spatial computing at European Union gatherings (European Parliament and Commission members) and for United Nations delegations.
- Entrepreneur in Residence at the University of Copenhagen (KU Lighthouse) since 2022.
- Founder of NXT/WebXR (2025), a discovery platform for WebXR experiences: https://www.nxtwebxr.com
- Co-founder and XR architect of MidwifeXR/MidwifeVR, a VR breastfeeding-guidance platform used in the midwifery curriculum at University College Copenhagen (KP).
- Builds WebXR and immersive applications for hospitals (e.g. Herlev Hospital), museums and global brands.
- Speaks English and Danish.

- IDA Driving Health Tech keynote: spatial computing in maternity care
- Future Sound Forum (Danish Sound Cluster) panel with Bang & Olufsen: spatial audio and XR
- Berlingske podcast "Pilestræde": Apple Vision Pro analysis
- Radio4 Kulturmagasinet: what Apple Vision Pro means for the cultural industry
- Berlingske, 24Victoria, CBS Wire, The Copenhagen Post and Voice of America coverage

## Projects

- [NXT/WebXR](https://www.nxtwebxr.com): the front page of the spatial internet
- [SendToQuest](https://sendtoquest.com): open WebXR links on multiple headsets at once
